scope: Remaining work to publish this repository for other teams; consuming-project work stays in each project

items.title: Decide publication license and ownership
items.trigger: Before any external publication or remote creation
items.acceptance: Owner records the license/ownership decision, adds the license file and updates README provenance; no license is inferred from this extraction

items.title: Create remote and continuous integration
items.trigger: Owner approves remote creation and CI changes
items.acceptance: CI runs `python3 check.py` on supported Python versions and platforms; branch protections and review gates configured by the owner

items.title: Verify hash-locked optional dependencies on supported platforms
items.trigger: Before declaring optional setup supported beyond the original Linux/Python 3.14 resolution
items.acceptance: `bash setup.sh` result recorded per platform/Python version, or the lock is regenerated per platform with advisory and license review

items.title: Run real renderer and Trestle integration tests in this repository
items.acceptance: Framework suite run with TRESTLE_TEST_BIN, PANDOC_TEST_BIN and PLANTUML_TEST_JAR; results saved with versions; skipped optional tests are not reported as passed
items.verification: November 23 consolidated-repository run: 12 evidence tests + 35 framework tests, zero skips; actual Trestle assembly, PlantUML SVG/PNG and DOCX media checks using existing approved local tools. This does not verify fresh dependency installation on other platforms.

items.title: Complete renderer release environment and platform support
items.acceptance: Tracked by FW-14 in sspp-assembly-framework/work-items.json; setup_assembly.py currently supports Linux ARM64/AMD64 only

items.title: Provide a supported agent-skill registration path
items.trigger: Teams request agent-skill installation instructions for their harness
items.acceptance: Document tested registration steps for each supported harness; moving this directory alone does not register the skill
